spec.title: LLM Request Explorer
spec.description: Find single calls: slow, failed, expensive, cut off, or with huge prompts.

list.name: model_re
list.label: Model (regex)
list.description: Filter by model, for example claude-opus.* or anthropic/.*

list.name: status
list.label: Status
list.query: Any : true,Errors only : status=error,Succeeded only : status!=error

options.content:
Set **Source**, **Model (regex)** (`.*` for all, `claude-opus.*` for one family), **Slower than** and **Status** at the top; the first table follows all four, the saved searches follow Source and Model. Click a **trace ID** to open the trace: each span's attributes hold tokens, cache use, the stop reason and, with full-content export, the prompt and the response.

For anything else open **Explore** (compass icon), pick the traces datasource and write TraceQL, for example `{ resource.service.name = "claude-platform" && span.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens > 150000 }`.

panels.title: Matching calls
panels.description: Every call that matches the filters, newest first (up to 100).

panels.title: Failed calls
panels.description: Calls that ended with an error. The Error column says why.

panels.title: Slowest calls (over 30 s)
panels.description: Calls that took longer than 30 seconds.

panels.title: Cut off by the token limit
panels.description: Responses that stopped because they reached max_tokens. Raise max_tokens or ask for shorter output.

panels.title: Huge prompts (over 150K tokens)
panels.description: Calls whose prompt passed 150K tokens. Compaction or a fresh session usually helps.

panels.title: Expensive OpenRouter calls (over $0.05)
panels.description: Single OpenRouter generations that cost more than 5 cents.

panels.title: Claude cache misses on big prompts
panels.description: Claude requests over 20K input tokens that read almost nothing from the cache, so they paid full price for the prompt.
